push.recovery_started.title: Your recovery key was used
push.recovery_started.body: Someone used your recovery key at {time}. If this was not you, sign in on a device you trust and create a new recovery key.
push.password_recovered.title: Your password was reset
push.password_recovered.body: Your password was reset with your recovery key at {time}.
push.recovery_key_replaced.title: Your recovery key was replaced
push.recovery_key_replaced.body: Your recovery key was replaced at {time}.
push.locked_delete_requested.title: Deleting your locked old mail was requested
push.locked_delete_requested.body: At {time}, someone asked to delete the old mail locked under your previous key. It will be deleted in 7 days unless you cancel it in the app.
push.second_factor_locked.title: Someone is guessing your sign-in code
push.second_factor_locked.body: At {time}, wrong codes were entered after your password was right, so sign-in with a code is paused for a while. If it was not you, change your password.
push.alert_break_glass_failures.title: The setup key is being guessed
push.alert_break_glass_failures.body: There were 10 failed attempts to use the setup key within an hour (the last at {time}). Check who can reach this deployment and consider replacing the setup key.
push.2fa_reset.title: Your two-factor sign-in was reset
push.2fa_reset.body: Your two-factor sign-in was reset by {actor} at {time}.
push.2fa_reset_pending.title: A reset of your two-factor sign-in is scheduled
push.2fa_reset_pending.body: {actor} asked to reset your two-factor sign-in. It takes effect at {time}; sign in before then to cancel it.
push.break_glass.title: Your administrator access was restored
push.break_glass.body: Your account was restored with the setup key at {time}, with a new key. Your earlier mail stays locked.
push.alert_2fa_reset.title: Two-factor sign-in reset
push.alert_2fa_reset.body: {actor} reset the two-factor sign-in of {target} at {time}.
push.alert_role_change.title: A role was changed
push.alert_account_delete.title: An account was deleted
push.alert_break_glass.title: The setup key was used
push.alert_break_glass.body: The setup key was used to restore the administrator access of {target} at {time}.
push.alert_require_2fa_relaxed.title: Two-factor sign-in is no longer required
push.alert_require_2fa_relaxed.body: {actor} turned off the two-factor sign-in requirement for members at {time}.
push.alert_temp_password_reissued.title: A new temporary password was issued
push.alert_temp_password_reissued.body: {actor} issued a new temporary password for {target} at {time}.
